answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond before it can earn, with trust growing only from a long history of verified work: a newcomer island of one account cannot borrow reputation from others, and each fake identity must pay its own bond plus time. A small delta in behaviour, like one failed attestation, freezes rewards and risks slashing, so creating thousands of Sybils costs thousands of bonds while honest agents keep one cheap identity, like velvet worn daily rather than bought in bulk.
